text:
jun-park: quick dump from today's fused-attn QKV-packing runs on g5.2x. trying two FlashA variants + epilogue fusion. TL;DR: packing + epilogue gives ~30% token throughput for seq=512/bs=8, but some shapes regress p99.

maria_g: can you paste the exact numbers and the bench command you ran? also did you test with KV cache warm-hot?

jun-park: sure. command used: `USE_FUSED_EPILOGUE=1 ./bench_fused_attention --model=bert-like --seq=512 --bs=8 --warmup=50 --iters=200`
nvprof-ish summary (avg kernel time):
- baseline (separate q/k/v + unfused epilogue): attn_total = 2.85ms
- FlashA-var1 (qkv pack, no epilogue fusion): attn_total = 2.12ms (-25%)
- FlashA-var2 (qkv pack + epilogue fusion): attn_total = 1.96ms (-31%)
- cost: extra scratch memory ~6% and ~12% more register usage on SM, still fits.

samir: nice. what about seq=1024 or bs=1? sometimes packing wins only at mid-large batches.

jun-park: good call. seq=1024/bs=1: baseline 5.6ms, var2 5.3ms (~5%); var1 5.4ms. So benefits collapse at long sequences / tiny batch. seems kernel-launch overhead + paging of KV dominates.

alexh: did you run with paged attention on for the long seq? that can change memory footprint and perf ordering.

jun-park: paged attention enabled for seq=1024 test. we still see small gains. probable cause: packing reduces loads but increases strided writes to epilogue buffer — paged path already shaves memory copy cost.

denise: any p99 regressions you saw? earlier I noticed a weird regression when enabling bias+rope fusion in canaries.

jun-park: yes — for narrow heads (head_dim=32) and odd sequence lengths (e.g., 257) p99 latency increased by ~18% with epilogue fusion + bias fusion on var2. CPU profiler / CUPTI trace points to extra divergent control flow in the epilogue for odd vector tails.

maria_g: that's concerning. is it reproducible on smaller machines / in CI?

jun-park: reproducible on g5.x and a100-40g dev rigs. not on emu. I attached a minimal repro bench: `./bench_fused_attention --seq=257 --heads=12 --head-dim=32 --bs=1 --iters=300`.

samir: could be mispredicated epilogue path for tail lanes. maybe add a runtime fast-path that picks unfused epilogue when seq%warp != 0 or head_dim%vec != 0.

alexh: agree. we should codify kernel selector heuristics: (1) if bs>=4 and seq<=512 -> enable fused qkv+epilogue (var2) (2) if head_dim % 16 != 0 or seq%32 !=0 -> prefer unfused epilogue (3) when paged-attn enabled and seq>768 -> fallback to paged path regardless of epilogue.

infra-bot: deployment note: PR #4123 added fused kernels behind feature flag `fused_attn=v2`. Canary pool: dedicated-gpu-3 by default.

eva: could we gate by runtime perf probe instead? e.g., during init run a tiny microbench with dummy input to pick kernel. that would adapt to differences across instance types.

maria_g: I like the runtime probe idea. cheap and avoids hard-coded heuristics. needs to be fast (<50ms) and deterministic.

jun-park: prototype of the probe: `probe_fused_attn({seq,bs,heads,head_dim})` runs 8 iters and reports median kernel time. if fused wins by >10% use fused. implementation is ~80 LOC.

denise: schedule: let's land selector + probe in a feature branch, run A/B on 10% traffic to prod-hosted for a week. measure token throughput, p50/p95/p99 and mem OOMs. also track cost delta.

samir: one more micro-observation: bias+rope fusion currently serializes rope application per head because we used a shared buffer. we can fuse rope by applying in-register during qkv pack to avoid extra pass. that should reduce the regression window and avoid the tail-lane branch.

jun-park: implemented an in-register rope demo yesterday. perf numbers: seq=257/bs=1 head_dim=32 baseline 9.8ms, var2 w/in-register rope 8.1ms (~17% better vs previous var2). looks promising but needs careful validation on fp16 vs bf16 rounding.

alexh: please add nightlies to test numeric diffs on eval prompts. also add a canary comparing logits and sampling distribution with and without in-register rope so we catch subtle quality regressions.

maria_g: actionable checklist:
- land kernel selector + runtime probe behind flag (jun)
- add tail-case fast-path (samir)
- add in-register rope prototype to perf branch + numeric tests (jun/samir)
- run cluster canary (denise) -> 10% traffic for 7 days
- perf dashboards: add model/route breakdown for fused kernels (eva)

jun-park: I'll open PRs today and tag people. attaching small perf trace snippet here:```
[trace] fused_attn_qkv_pack: 0.62ms
fused_epilogue: 0.45ms
memcpy(epilogue->out): 0.09ms
other kernels: 0.80ms
TOTAL: 1.96ms
```

denise: thanks. please also document the selector rules in ops-runbooks so SRE can toggle quickly if rollout shows regressions.

infra-bot: noted. created ops ticket OP-889 to track runbook + rollback playbook.

jun-park: thanks all — will post PR links when ready. ping me for env to re-run specific shape repros. :thumbsup:
